# Buzz author types

This archive contains the official type-only author declarations generated with `pnpm author:build` from Buzz v1.0.0, commit `4fb386b0be5966f5ad9e930a33d1c75b432625fb`. The archive includes Buzz’s Apache-2.0 license and notices.

[Source and packaging instructions](https://github.com/block/buzz-app/blob/v1.0.0/docs/plugin-architecture.md#the-buzzodz-cli)
